label: Memberwise actual concurrent giving of being to the contingent concrete inventory
definition: ConcurrentTotalityGivingAt f Concrete v c requires at least one actual giving of being by the same concrete source c to a contingent concrete member x at a moment t of x's presence in history v, and requires f.GivesAt v c x t for every contingent concrete individual and every moment at which it is present. The relation f.GivesAt is the existing primitive of concurrent giving-of-being, not a merely supplied arbitrary totality-cause label. Concrete existence and exteriority of c are not entailed by this definition: they are supplied by the separate opportunity premise. The memberwise reading is stronger than an explanation of the contingent totality as one collective whole.
note: Analyst semantic extension of Arrival B. Intentionally does not equate concurrent esse-giving with ordinary earlier efficient cause, Ontic.Causes, mere intrinsic dispositions, or existential grounding of every member by a holistic cause. A stronger causal conclusion uses this field in the result; the existence and metaphysical possibility of the source remain OPEN.
